responsibility: Public declarations for RTL SSA basic-block and extended-basic-block metadata. This header defines bb_info for the SSA view of a CFG block, ebb_info for grouped execution chains with phi and call-clobber lists, and the iterator and printing interfaces that expose block order, containment, and instruction ranges to the rest of the RTL SSA subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Defines the bb_info, ebb_info, and ebb_call_clobbers_info abstractions and their traversal/printing interfaces that blocks.cc fills and uses; unlike blocks.cc, it describes the persistent block/EBB metadata structure rather than the CFG-to-SSA construction process.
